dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study was to test the effectiveness of prohexadione calcium (PC) as a plant growth regulator (PGR) at different rates on a mixed stand canopy at fairway height under northern temperate conditions using an extended growing degree (GDD) day application schedule. Additionally, this study aimed to capture the rebound effect measured after regulation loss and subsequent applications of PC.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Plant growth regulation and the rebound effect when prohexadione calcium is applied to fairway height annual bluegrass and creeping bentgrass swards
